
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Cleaner — Discord Bot</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#1c1c1f;
  --bg2:#232327;
  --bg3:#2a2a2e;
  --surf:#303036;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --line2:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
  --white:#f2f2f4;
  --muted:#76767f;
  --dim:#4e4e58;
  --accent:#c0bfcb;
  --purple:#a89bef;
  --pdim:rgba(168,155,239,0.13);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}

/* NAV */
nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 clamp(1rem,5vw,4rem);
  height:58px;
  background:rgba(28,28,31,0.92);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.brand{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.1rem;
  color:var(--white);text-decoration:none;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
}
.brand-icon{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;
  background:#e8e8ed;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;
}
.brand-icon img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:contain}
.navlinks{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem}
.navlinks a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;transition:color .2s}
.navlinks a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.nadinv{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:var(--pdim);border:1px solid rgba(168,155,239,.3);
  color:var(--purple);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:.32rem .85rem;border-radius:100px;
  text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.nadinv:hover{background:rgba(168,155,239,.22)}
.nadinv svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex-shrink:0}

/* HERO */
.hero{
  min-height:100svh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;
  padding:5rem 1.5rem 3rem;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:25%;left:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:600px;height:600px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(168,155,239,.07) 0%,transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.icon-wrap{
  width:110px;height:110px;
  border-radius:26px;
  background:#e8e8ed;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:2rem;
  animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
  box-shadow:0 8px 36px rgba(168,155,239,.14);
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.icon-wrap img{width:76px;height:76px;object-fit:contain}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-13px)}}
.htag{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  background:var(--pdim);border:1px solid rgba(168,155,239,.22);
  color:var(--purple);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:.36rem 1rem;border-radius:100px;
  margin-bottom:1.25rem;animation:fup .7s .1s both;
}
.htag-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.hero h1{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(3.2rem,12vw,9rem);
  letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;
  color:var(--white);margin-bottom:1rem;
  animation:fup .7s .2s both;
}
.hero-sub{
  font-size:clamp(.9rem,2.5vw,1.1rem);
  color:var(--muted);max-width:400px;
  margin-bottom:2.25rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.65;
  animation:fup .7s .3s both;
}
.invbtn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  background:var(--purple);color:#0e0d17;
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:700;
  font-size:.87rem;letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding:.72rem 1.75rem;border-radius:100px;
  text-decoration:none;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s;
  box-shadow:0 4px 22px rgba(168,155,239,.26);
  animation:fup .7s .4s both;margin-bottom:3rem;
}
.invbtn:hover{background:#c0b4ff;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(168,155,239,.35)}
.invbtn svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0}
.scroll-hint{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  color:var(--dim);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  animation:fadein 1s 1.2s both;
}
.scroll-line{width:1px;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--dim),transparent)}
@keyframes fup{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes fadein{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}

/* SECTIONS */
.sec{max-width:840px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(3.5rem,8vw,6.5rem) 1.5rem}
.divider{max-width:840px;margin:0 auto;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.slabel{
  display:inline-block;
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple);margin-bottom:.6rem;
}
.sec h2{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.6rem);
  letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--white);
  margin-bottom:1.75rem;line-height:1.1;
}
.sec p{color:#88889a;font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:.9rem;max-width:660px;line-height:1.7}
.sec p strong{color:var(--accent);font-weight:500}

/* COMMANDS */
.cmd-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));
  gap:1px;background:var(--line);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;
}
.cmd-card{
  background:var(--bg2);padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;
  transition:background .2s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.cmd-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 0 0,rgba(168,155,239,.06),transparent 55%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;
}
.cmd-card:hover{background:var(--bg3)}
.cmd-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.cpill{
  display:inline-block;
  background:rgba(168,155,239,.1);border:1px solid rgba(168,155,239,.17);
  color:#9090c4;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.13em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:.2rem .58rem;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:.8rem;
}
.cname{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:800;
  font-size:1.35rem;letter-spacing:.03em;
  color:var(--purple);margin-bottom:.45rem;
}
.cdesc{font-size:.83rem;color:#787898;line-height:1.58}

/* LEGAL */
.lblock{
  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  border-radius:12px;padding:1.6rem 1.8rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem;
}
.lblock h3{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:700;
  font-size:.95rem;color:var(--accent);
  margin-bottom:.45rem;letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.lblock p{margin:0;font-size:.86rem;color:#88889a;line-height:1.7}

/* FOOTER */
footer{
  background:var(--bg);border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  text-align:center;padding:2rem 1.5rem;
  color:var(--dim);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.04em;
}
footer a{color:var(--dim);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
footer a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.foot-brand{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1rem;
  color:var(--muted);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:.85rem;
}
.foot-icon{
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:#e8e8ed;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
}
.foot-icon img{width:16px;height:16px;object-fit:contain}

/* REVEAL */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .65s,transform .65s}
.rv.on{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* MOBILE */
@media(max-width:640px){
  .navlinks .navlink-hide{display:none}
  .icon-wrap{width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:20px}
  .icon-wrap img{width:60px;height:60px}
  .lblock{padding:1.1rem 1.25rem}
  .cmd-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav>
  <span class="brand">
    <div class="brand-icon"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt=""></div>
    Cleaner
  </span>
  <div class="navlinks">
    <a class="navlink-hide" href="#commands">Commands</a>
    <a class="navlink-hide" href="#tos">Terms</a>
    <a class="navlink-hide" href="#privacy">Privacy</a>
    <a class="nadinv" href="https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1492250906819825764" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20.317 4.37a19.791 19.791 0 0 0-4.885-1.515.074.074 0 0 0-.079.037c-.21.375-.444.864-.608 1.25a18.27 18.27 0 0 0-5.487 0 12.64 12.64 0 0 0-.617-1.25.077.077 0 0 0-.079-.037A19.736 19.736 0 0 0 3.677 4.37a.07.07 0 0 0-.032.027C.533 9.046-.32 13.58.099 18.057c.002.022.015.043.033.056a19.909 19.909 0 0 0 5.993 3.03.078.078 0 0 0 .084-.028 14.09 14.09 0 0 0 1.226-1.994.076.076 0 0 0-.041-.106 13.107 13.107 0 0 1-1.872-.892.077.077 0 0 1-.008-.128 10.2 10.2 0 0 0 .372-.292.074.074 0 0 1 .077-.01c3.928 1.793 8.18 1.793 12.062 0a.074.074 0 0 1 .078.01c.12.098.246.198.373.292a.077.077 0 0 1-.006.127 12.299 12.299 0 0 1-1.873.892.077.077 0 0 0-.041.107c.36.698.772 1.362 1.225 1.993a.076.076 0 0 0 .084.028 19.839 19.839 0 0 0 6.002-3.03.077.077 0 0 0 .032-.054c.5-5.177-.838-9.674-3.549-13.66a.061.061 0 0 0-.031-.03z"/></svg>
      Add to Discord
    </a>
  </div>
</nav>

<div class="hero" id="hero">
  <div class="icon-wrap">
    <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Cleaner icon">
  </div>
  <div class="htag"><div class="htag-dot"></div>Discord Bot</div>
  <h1>Cleaner</h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">Keep your server spotless. Block scams, purge spam, and automate message cleanup — all in one bot.</p>
  <a class="invbtn" href="https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1492250906819825764" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20.317 4.37a19.791 19.791 0 0 0-4.885-1.515.074.074 0 0 0-.079.037c-.21.375-.444.864-.608 1.25a18.27 18.27 0 0 0-5.487 0 12.64 12.64 0 0 0-.617-1.25.077.077 0 0 0-.079-.037A19.736 19.736 0 0 0 3.677 4.37a.07.07 0 0 0-.032.027C.533 9.046-.32 13.58.099 18.057c.002.022.015.043.033.056a19.909 19.909 0 0 0 5.993 3.03.078.078 0 0 0 .084-.028 14.09 14.09 0 0 0 1.226-1.994.076.076 0 0 0-.041-.106 13.107 13.107 0 0 1-1.872-.892.077.077 0 0 1-.008-.128 10.2 10.2 0 0 0 .372-.292.074.074 0 0 1 .077-.01c3.928 1.793 8.18 1.793 12.062 0a.074.074 0 0 1 .078.01c.12.098.246.198.373.292a.077.077 0 0 1-.006.127 12.299 12.299 0 0 1-1.873.892.077.077 0 0 0-.041.107c.36.698.772 1.362 1.225 1.993a.076.076 0 0 0 .084.028 19.839 19.839 0 0 0 6.002-3.03.077.077 0 0 0 .032-.054c.5-5.177-.838-9.674-3.549-13.66a.061.061 0 0 0-.031-.03z"/></svg>
    Add to Discord
  </a>
  <div class="scroll-hint">Scroll<div class="scroll-line"></div></div>
</div>

<section class="sec rv" id="commands">
  <span class="slabel">What it does</span>
  <h2>Commands &amp; Functions</h2>
  <div class="cmd-grid">
    <div class="cmd-card">
      <div class="cpill">Moderation</div>
      <div class="cname">/banpot</div>
      <p class="cdesc">Creates a protection channel that auto-detects MrBeast scam bots and NSFW spam — offenders get kicked instantly before causing any damage.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cmd-card">
      <div class="cpill">Cleanup</div>
      <div class="cname">/purge</div>
      <p class="cdesc">Bulk-delete a specific number of messages from any channel in seconds. Just set the count and Cleaner handles the rest.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cmd-card">
      <div class="cpill">Automation</div>
      <div class="cname">/clean</div>
      <p class="cdesc">Start an automated cleanup that removes messages older than a date you choose — keeping channels fresh with zero manual effort.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cmd-card">
      <div class="cpill">Config</div>
      <div class="cname">/prefix</div>
      <p class="cdesc">Change the bot's command prefix to fit your server. Set it once and every command adapts to the new prefix immediately.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cmd-card">
      <div class="cpill">Help</div>
      <div class="cname">/help</div>
      <p class="cdesc">Shows every available command with descriptions, usage examples, and required permissions — always up to date.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<section class="sec rv" id="tos">
  <span class="slabel">Legal</span>
  <h2>Terms of Service</h2>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>1 · Acceptable Use</h3><p>By adding Cleaner to your Discord server you agree to these Terms. The bot must not be used for unlawful purposes, harassment, or any activity that violates Discord's own Terms of Service. Abuse may result in a permanent blacklist.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>2 · Server Owner Responsibility</h3><p>Server owners and administrators are solely responsible for how Cleaner is configured and used within their server. We are not liable for moderation actions taken by the bot based on your team's configuration.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>3 · Availability</h3><p>We aim to keep Cleaner online at all times but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. The bot may go offline for maintenance or updates without prior notice.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>4 · Changes to Terms</h3><p>These terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the bot after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised terms.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>5 · Termination</h3><p>We reserve the right to restrict or terminate Cleaner's access to any server or user at our sole discretion, particularly in cases of abuse or violation of these terms.</p></div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<section class="sec rv" id="privacy">
  <span class="slabel">Your data</span>
  <h2>Privacy Policy</h2>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>1 · Data We Collect</h3><p>Cleaner collects only what is strictly necessary: server IDs, channel IDs, and configuration preferences such as custom prefixes and clean schedules. We do <strong>not</strong> store the content of any deleted messages.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>2 · How Data Is Used</h3><p>Collected data is used exclusively to provide and improve the bot's features inside your Discord server. We do not sell, share, or monetize any data.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>3 · Data Storage &amp; Retention</h3><p>Configuration data is stored securely and kept only while Cleaner is active in your server. When you remove the bot, your data is deleted within <strong>30 days</strong>.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>4 · Third Parties</h3><p>Cleaner does not share your data with any third-party service. The bot operates solely within the Discord platform and complies with Discord's Developer Terms of Service.</p></div>
  <div class="lblock"><h3>5 · Your Rights</h3><p>You may request deletion of all data associated with your server at any time by contacting the developer on Discord. We will process your request promptly.</p></div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="foot-brand">
    <div class="foot-icon"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt=""></div>
    Cleaner
  </div>
  <p style="margin-bottom:.65rem">
    <a href="#commands">Commands</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
    <a href="#tos">Terms of Service</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
    <a href="#privacy">Privacy Policy</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
    <a href="https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1492250906819825764" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Add to Discord</a>
  </p>
  <p>© 2026 Cleaner Bot — All rights reserved.</p>
</footer>

<script>
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('on')}),{threshold:.08});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
</script>
</body>
</html>
